 Follow Naomi Watts’ Ashi Studio Couture Is an Old Hollywood Dream
 Catherine Kallon Wed, October 28, 2026 at 2:59 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Naomi Watts joined her co-stars Kim Kardashian and Sarah Paulson at Soho House in Mexico City on Tuesday for the All's Fair season two presentation.
 Medios y Media/Getty Images
 The actress has been on an incredible run throughout this press tour, and that continued with this Ashi Studio Spring 2026 Couture look.
 I'm absolutely enamoured with the sculpted, pearl-embellished corset and its braided neckline. There is something wonderfully Old Hollywood about piece, with the corset reminding me of those ornate 1930s French Baroque-style boudoir lamps, particularly the way the delicate beaded fringe falls from the waist. It's an unusual comparison, I know, but I can't unsee it, and I love it.
 Medios y Media/Getty Images
 The fluid ivory silk skirt is the perfect complement, allowing the intricate craftsmanship of the corset to take centre stage while giving the entire look a beautiful sense of elegance.

 Stylist: Jeanann Williams.
